answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 163447 Country: United Kingdom Title: Regarding salat-ul- lail with jamat Question: In our local mosque, they perform, announce tahajjud in the congregation during the last 10 nights of Ramadan. Is this is allowed? Further witr is read 2 rakahs and after salaam one rakah. Even Hanafi Imam also performs same as Shafai Imam. Is it allowed? Answer ID: 163447 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1049/911/B=11/1439) (1) According to Hanafi Fiqh it is makrooh to offer tahajjud salah in congregation with tada’i i.e. there are more than three muqtadis. It is even worse to call people by announcing for doing makrooh task. (2) According to Hanafi Fiqh it is wajib to offer three rakah of witr with single salam. If someone offered witr salah in a way that he offered two rakah with one salam and then one rakah with another salam then as per Hanafi Fiqh this witr will not be valid. It is mandatory for him to offer three rakah with one salam, this is the preferred opinion. It is not lawful for a Hanafi Imam to lead witr salah with two salam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
